definition: מַכְפֵּלָה proper name, of a location near Hebron , where the patriarchs and their wives were buried, only in P , always with article; ׳ שׂדה אשׁר בַּמּ Gen 23:17 , ׳ מְעָדַת הַמּ the cave of Machpelah v Gen 23:9 , Gen 25:9 , מְעָרַת ׳ שְׂדֵה הַמּ Gen 23:19 ; Gen 50:13 , ׳ מְעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה הַמּ Gen 49:30 . — compare Buhl Geogr. 160, 161. — (Evidently originally appellative, but meaning dubious; ᵐ5 τό διπλοῦν ; according to Thes = part, lot , portion , as Ethiopic ).

מַכְפֵּלָה proper name, of a location near Hebron, where the patriarchs and their wives were buried, only in P, always with article; ׳שׂדה אשׁר בַּמּ Gen 23:17, ׳מְעָדַת הַמּ the cave of Machpelah vGen 23:9, Gen 25:9, מְעָרַת׳שְׂדֵה הַמּ Gen 23:19; Gen 50:13, ׳מְעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה הַמּ Gen 49:30. — compare BuhlGeogr. 160, 161. — (Evidently originally appellative, but meaning dubious; ᵐ5 τό διπλοῦν; according to Thes = part, lot, portion, as Ethiopic ).
